mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery P360 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete rebuilt Land Rover Discovery P360 engine typically costs between £6,500 and £10,000 for supply only [EM-QUOTE]. Used units start from around £2,500. Reconditioned units range from £4,500 to £7,500. Prices vary based on the specific AJ20P6 / 306PS engine code and supplier.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of cooling system failure in a Discovery P360?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include unexplained coolant loss, a sweet smell from the engine bay, or dashboard warning lights indicating low coolant levels. Unusual engine noises or knocking due to overheating. Reduced performance or limp mode activation. Steam or visible leaks under the vehicle after driving.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Discovery P360?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. The Land Rover Discovery P360 is a high-value premium SUV with current market values ranging from £30,000 to over £80,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A rebuilt engine cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's total value. It preserves the car's towing capability, refinement, and resale value. Upgraded rebuilt units address known factory cooling component weaknesses.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Discovery P360 engine supply and fit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional Land Rover Discovery P360 engine replacement typically takes 3 to 5 working days. Removal and preparation of the old unit takes 1-2 days. Fitting, calibration, and 48V MHEV system testing of the new rebuilt engine takes 2-3 days. Nationwide collection and delivery are arranged by the specialist.

mainEntity.name: Do rebuilt P360 engines retain the 48V mild-hybrid (MHEV) functionality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, reputable specialists rebuilding a Land Rover Discovery P360 engine ensure full compatibility with the 48V mild-hybrid architecture. The integrated starter-generator (ISG) and associated electrical components are tested and calibrated. All MHEV software maps are retained or updated to factory specifications. This ensures seamless stop-start operation and torque-fill performance.

milestones.description: AJ20P6 / 306PS (3.0L I6 MHEV Petrol), 360PS (355bhp), introduced in the Discovery 5 facelift, featuring an integrated starter-generator and refined turbocharging for seamless torque delivery.

commonProblems.h3: The 3.0L Ingenium inline-six in the Land Rover Discovery P360 is a highly capable, modern powertrain. While generally robust, its complex mild-hybrid architecture and cooling systems require precise maintenance. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Cooling System & Water Pump Vulnerability - Why the Land Rover Discovery P360 AJ20P6 Requires Attention
problems.typicalFailureMileage: 60,000-120,000 miles (projected based on Ingenium family patterns)
problems.rootCause: Plastic coolant crossover pipes and electric water pump components can degrade under repeated heat cycles, leading to coolant loss and potential overheating if not addressed promptly.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Coolant flush, electric water pump inspection, and seal replacement
repairOptions.longevity: Highly suitable for minor leaks before overheating occurs

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt 3.0L I6 with upgraded cooling components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if coolant loss has caused severe overheating and warped components

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Discovery P360 holds a current UK market value of £30,000-£80,000+ depending on specification and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. At this valuation, a rebuilt engine replacement cost represents a small fraction of the vehicle's total value, making professional replacement highly viable to preserve its premium status.
problems.recommendation: Proactive inspection and replacement of the electric water pump and coolant crossover pipes is a highly recommended, low-cost preventative measure. If overheating has already occurred, a full rebuilt engine replacement is the safest and most reliable solution to protect your investment.
